results.overview: When Maria is found dead under mysterious circumstances, Detective Garcia becomes entangled in a case that challenges both his logic and his sanity. His partner, Fortunato, seems to know more than he is willing to reveal.

results.title: Behindd
results.overview: The film is about a mother's (Sonia Agarwal) struggle to protect her daughter from some terrifying experiences. Initially her husband (Jinu E Thomas) ignore her words, but later he too experiences the same. The movie continues with the question whether the family will succeed to overcome the situation or not and what will be the further changes in their life...

results.title: Never Alone for Christmas: Memphis
results.overview: Two Memphis women with big hearts — a dating coach and a once-great Beale Street blues singer — find themselves unexpectedly alone for Christmas. Determined not to spend the holidays in heartbreak, they form an unlikely friendship and help each other take bold steps toward love, healing, and second chances — all set to the rhythm of Memphis soul.

results.title: Last Known Backup
results.overview: Enigmatic devices shatter five timelines, altering the lives of Steve, Ray, Verona, Oakley, Xiomara, Mitch, and Dominica. As chaos spreads, they're forced to rise, facing the unknown to reclaim their futures-and stop what's coming.

results.title: L3: Lipad
results.overview: A woman becomes entangled in a provocative relationship where her husband begins offering her to others for pleasure. What starts as an exhilarating exploration of desire slowly unravels, forcing her to face the emotional and moral consequences of their choices.

results.title: Trinity of Tales
results.overview: From drama, comedy, to horror, every genre has become a space for expressions of love for film, fashion and photography artists. Three short films in three different genres that show the character and characteristics of their respective aesthetic views, are a form of respect for various styles of storytelling from different perspectives.

results.title: ACA 183: Tumenov vs. Vagaev
results.overview: ACA 183: Tumenov vs. Vagaev was a mixed martial arts event that took place on Saturday, February 8, 2025 the Basket Hall in Krasnodar, Russia.

results.title: Fireflies in the Dusk
results.overview: When Charlotte's mother Edith forces her to marry the catty and acerbic Cecil, Charlotte time travels from the Victorian era into the modern time to be with her beloved pen pal, Zachary. Unfortunately, Charlotte's plan goes awry when Cecil follows her through the time portal.

results.title: Holy Rollers
results.overview: Eve, in love with her best friend Rebeccah, agrees to secure alcohol for the end-of-year youth group party in hopes to gain her favor. However, during this endeavor Eve is caught in the middle of a drug war between locals and the largest church in Jefferson County, where she must save both her town and her love, Rebeccah.

results.title: To Fathers and Mothers
results.overview: Created for the municipality of Pergola, the film offers insight into the city's identity and historical context. It covers events across much of the country, juxtaposing land and war. We also hear the voices of Simone Massi's children. The author dedicates this work "to his children and to these children."

results.title: The Hugger
results.overview: Different people seek solace from a professional hugger

results.title: The Spirit of Christmas Station
results.overview: With a Christmas deadline looming, literary editor Isabell retreats to her family's cabin in a quaint town where she spent her holidays as a little girl. Finding the town in a slump, the inspiration she is looking for comes from a local rancher who helps her both revive the annual Christmas Festival and discover the ending to her own story.

results.title: Worries
results.overview: Four short stories unfold in a sleepy Jerusalem neighborhood, where everyday troubles collide with one looming misfortune that threatens to tie them all together.

results.title: In the Room
results.overview: In the face of exile, five Afghan women’s commitment to freedom and equality empowers them to take the world stage and reclaim their homeland. Through a series of honest conversations, these extraordinary rebels reveal the deeply personal history of Afghanistan in all its complexity, beauty and struggle.
